## Key Context

1. The `feedback/view.rs` file currently:
   - IMPORTS from `super::utils::{..., feedback_classification, feedback_title_and_placeholder, gutter, issue_url_for_category}` (line 30-33)
   - ALSO DEFINES those same functions inline (lines ~329-368)
   - The fix: remove the inline definitions since they conflict with imports

2. The `view.rs` at line 479 inside a function body uses:
   ```rust
   use super::popup_consts::standard_popup_hint_line;
   ```
   But `super` = `bottom_pane::feedback` which has no `popup_consts`. Fix: use the one already imported at the top of the file (line 26: `use crate::bottom_pane::popup_consts::standard_popup_hint_line;`) and remove the inline import.

3. The `super::SelectionViewParams`, `super::SelectionItem`, `super::SelectionAction` references in `view.rs` need to point to the correct module. Check `bottom_pane/mod.rs` - it has `pub(crate) use list_selection_view::SelectionViewParams;`, so the fix is to use `crate::bottom_pane::SelectionViewParams` etc.
